assessment_objectives.objective: elements of sensitive and/or regulated data to be de-identified are defined.
the frequency at which to evaluate the effectiveness of de-identification is defined.
sensitive and/or regulated data is anonymized by removing the defined data elements from datasets.
the effectiveness of de-identification is evaluated at the defined frequency.
sensitive and/or regulated data is de-identified by removing, masking, encrypting, hashing or replacing direct identifiers in a dataset.
the de-identification technique(s) to be applied to sensitive and/or regulated data (anonymization, de-identification, pseudonymization and/or redaction) are defined.
sensitive and/or regulated data is pseudonymized by replacing direct identifiers with pseudonyms, with any information needed to re-identify the data held separately and protected.
sensitive and/or regulated data elements are redacted from datasets, documents and/or outputs where those elements are not needed.
